definitions: a short, loud, ringing sound, like that made by two metal objects hitting each other
a serious disagreement or argument between people or groups
a situation in which two events happen at the same time in a way that is inconvenient
a situation in which two colours or styles look unpleasant together
examples: The clash of cymbals was deafening.
There was a clash between the two political parties.
The concert had a clash with another important event.
The red and orange created a terrible clash.
